name: get_project_summary
title: Get project summary
description: Read aggregate project health and task counts from page-local state. Use only for project-level summaries; never use this tool to find, filter, resolve, or select task records. Use search_tasks for any task lookup or task-based mutation.

output.description: The current project name, health, total task count, and number of in-progress tasks.

statusMessages.complete: The latest project health is ready.

name: search_tasks
title: Search tasks
description: Find and resolve task records already loaded in this page by title, owner, priority, or status. This is the required tool for every task lookup, including selecting tasks for an 'all' request. Use the returned exact task IDs before changing status or priority; do not use get_project_summary for task discovery.

query.description: The original task description or search text from the user

output.description: An array of matching task records with their IDs, titles, owners, statuses, priorities, and due dates.

name: get_current_user
title: Get current user
description: Read the signed-in user and permissions from the local session state.

output.description: The signed-in user's profile, role, permissions, and local session source.

name: set_task_status
title: Set task status
description: Update the status of one task identified by an exact task ID returned by search_tasks, then return the updated task. This tool does not find tasks.

status.description: Status is case-insensitive; use "In progress" for active work.

output.description: The updated task record, or an error object when the status or task ID is invalid.

errorExamples.error: Invalid status. Use one of: Todo, In progress, Done

statusMessages.complete: The task status has been updated.

name: set_task_priority
title: Set task priority
description: Update the priority of one task identified by an exact task ID returned by search_tasks, then return the updated task. This tool does not find tasks.

priority.description: Priority is case-insensitive; use High, Medium, or Low.

output.description: The updated task record, or an error object when the priority or task ID is invalid.

errorExamples.error: Invalid priority. Use one of: High, Medium, Low

statusMessages.complete: The task priority has been updated.
